about.title: Advanced Machine Intelligence Research Lab.
about.introduction: Founded in 2020, Advanced Machine Intelligence Research Lab (AMIR Lab) is a non-profit academic consortium based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Its members include researchers and collaborators from universities and industry.
about.missionTitle: Research, development, and researcher training in AI.
about.missionBody: AMIR Lab works on interdisciplinary artificial intelligence research, develops practical systems, supports researcher education, and promotes responsible research practice.
about.organizationBody: The lab includes advisors, researchers, research assistants, interns, and administrative contributors working across research departments and partner institutions.
about.closingBody: Explore current projects and publications, meet the research team, or apply for an open position.

vision.summary: AMIR Lab aims to expand collaborative artificial intelligence research and its application in areas including healthcare, agriculture, security, and education.

people.biography: Prof. Dr. Muhammad Firoz Mridha is an academic and AI researcher with more than 20 years of teaching, research, and leadership experience in Computer Science and Engineering. He is a Professor at American International University-Bangladesh and the Founder and Director of the Advanced Machine Intelligence Research Lab. His research spans artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, large language models, and natural language processing.
